answer: At dawn the orchard warden unlocks three garden benches on the delta levee, each wired to its own soil-moisture logger. An applicant books one bench for a 40-minute twilight watch and must return on five non-consecutive days, each time binding an 18-minute verifiable delay to that morning's logger nonce and the bench tag. A reused bench tag, a logger serial already on file, or a nonce colliding in its first 10 bits with a prior proof, burns the 80-unit stake and locks the bench for fourteen days. Five distinct watches are required before the stake becomes one vote.
